AudioCraft Lite - Project Structure
====================================

audiocraft-lite/
│
├── 📄 Documentation
│   ├── README.md                    # Main project overview
│   ├── QUICKSTART.md               # 5-minute getting started guide
│   ├── SETUP.md                    # Detailed installation instructions
│   ├── FEATURES.md                 # Complete feature list
│   ├── COMPARISON.md               # Comparison with original AudioCraft
│   ├── ARCHITECTURE.md             # System design and data flow
│   ├── PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md        # File organization details
│   ├── TROUBLESHOOTING.md          # Common issues and solutions
│   ├── SUMMARY.md                  # Project summary
│   └── LICENSE                     # MIT License
│
├── 🐳 Docker Configuration
│   └── docker-compose.yml          # Docker Compose setup
│
├── 🔧 Backend (Python/FastAPI)
│   ├── main.py                     # FastAPI application & endpoints
│   ├── model_manager.py            # Model loading & audio generation
│   ├── config.py                   # Configuration settings
│   ├── requirements.txt            # Python dependencies
│   ├── Dockerfile                  # Backend Docker image
│   ├── start.sh                    # Linux/Mac startup script
│   ├── start.bat                   # Windows startup script
│   ├── outputs/                    # Generated audio files (runtime)
│   └── venv/                       # Python virtual environment
│
├── 🎨 Frontend (React)
│   ├── src/
│   │   ├── App.js                  # Main React component
│   │   ├── App.css                 # Component styling
│   │   ├── index.js                # React entry point
│   │   └── index.css               # Global styles
│   ├── public/
│   │   └── index.html              # HTML template
│   ├── package.json                # Node.js dependencies
│   ├── Dockerfile                  # Frontend Docker image
│   ├── nginx.conf                  # Nginx configuration
│   └── node_modules/               # Node dependencies (runtime)
│
├── 📚 Reference
│   └── audiocraft/                 # Original AudioCraft repo (cloned)
│
└── 🚫 .gitignore                   # Git ignore rules

Key Files Explained
===================

Backend Core Files:
-------------------
main.py              - API endpoints, CORS, server setup
model_manager.py     - Model loading, generation logic, cleanup
config.py            - All configuration in one place

Frontend Core Files:
--------------------
App.js               - UI components, state management, API calls
App.css              - Modern gradient design, responsive layout
index.js             - React initialization

Configuration Files:
--------------------
requirements.txt     - Minimal Python dependencies (13 packages)
package.json         - React dependencies and scripts
docker-compose.yml   - One-command deployment setup

Documentation Files:
--------------------
QUICKSTART.md        - Get running in 5 minutes
SETUP.md             - Detailed setup for all platforms
TROUBLESHOOTING.md   - Solutions to common problems
FEATURES.md          - What the app can do
COMPARISON.md        - vs Original AudioCraft
ARCHITECTURE.md      - How it all works together

File Sizes (Approximate):
=========================
Backend code:        ~15 KB (3 Python files)
Frontend code:       ~20 KB (4 JS/CSS files)
Documentation:       ~100 KB (9 markdown files)
Dependencies:        ~500 MB (Python + Node packages)
Models (cached):     ~500 MB - 1 GB (downloaded on first run)
Generated audio:     Varies (auto-cleanup enabled)

Total disk space:    ~1-2 GB

Directory Purposes:
===================

/backend/outputs/    - Stores generated WAV files
                     - Auto-cleanup keeps only recent files
                     - Served via /outputs/ endpoint

/backend/venv/       - Python virtual environment
                     - Isolates dependencies
                     - Created during setup

/frontend/build/     - Production React build
                     - Created by 'npm run build'
                     - Optimized static files

/frontend/node_modules/ - Node.js packages
                        - Created by 'npm install'
                        - ~500 MB

~/.cache/audiocraft-lite/ - Model cache (outside project)
                          - Shared across runs
                          - ~500 MB - 1 GB

Quick Navigation:
=================

Want to...                          Look at...
-----------                         ----------
Get started quickly                 QUICKSTART.md
Understand the project              README.md
Install step-by-step                SETUP.md
Fix an issue                        TROUBLESHOOTING.md
See all features                    FEATURES.md
Compare with original               COMPARISON.md
Understand architecture             ARCHITECTURE.md
Modify backend                      backend/main.py, model_manager.py
Modify frontend                     frontend/src/App.js
Change settings                     backend/config.py
Deploy with Docker                  docker-compose.yml
Add dependencies                    requirements.txt, package.json

Development Workflow:
=====================

1. Edit backend code → backend/*.py
2. Edit frontend code → frontend/src/*.js
3. Test locally → Run both servers
4. Build for production → npm run build
5. Deploy → Docker or manual

File Relationships:
===================

config.py
    ↓ imported by
main.py
    ↓ uses
model_manager.py
    ↓ loads
AudioCraft Models
    ↓ generates
Audio Files
    ↓ served to
Frontend (App.js)
    ↓ displays in
User Browser

This structure keeps everything organized, documented, and easy to navigate!
